Description

Quick Ship Indoor Walk-In Freezer, 6' W x 6' L x 7'-7" H, With Floor, 4” thick AK-XPS4 insulation providing R-29 for coolers & R-32 for freezers, 26 gauge stucco embossed corrosion resistant acrylic coated Acrylume on all interior & exterior surfaces, NSF aluminum floor rated at 600 Lbs./sq. ft. of uniformly distributed load, flush self-closing door, digital LED thermometer with pilot light switch, super cam-rise spring assisted hinges & door closer, ships in 48 hours - subject to terms & conditions, UL, Made in USA

Features:

  • 4" Thick AK-XPS4 insulation, providing R-29 for coolers and R-32 for freezers
  • 26 Gauge Acrylume® coated corrosion resistant stucco embossed Galvalume on all interior and exterior surfaces
  • 30”W x 76”H or 36”W x 76”H flush mounted door with spring actuated door closer
  • Smooth aluminum floor finish rated at 600 lbs per sq. ft. of uniformly distributed load
  • 2 Super cam-rise spring assisted hinges
  • Deadbolt keyed handle latch
  • Interior safety lock release handle
  • Digital LED thermometer with on and off pilot light switch
  • Vapor proof light fixture centered on interior door jamb

        Spec Sheet

        Walk-In Coolers and Freezers

        A walk-in cooler or freezer is a large, refrigerated room designed to store perishable items like food or beverages at consistent temperatures. They are commonly used in restaurants, supermarkets, and warehouses.

        Walk-in coolers come in various sizes, ranging from compact units for small kitchens to large-scale units for warehouses. Common sizes include 5’x6’, 6’x8’, and 10’x12’. Custom sizes are also available.

        Walk-in coolers help maintain consistent temperatures, reduce food spoilage, and provide ample storage for bulk goods. They also improve operational efficiency in commercial kitchens.

        Regular maintenance includes cleaning the condenser coils, checking door seals, and monitoring temperature settings. Proper upkeep extends the lifespan and efficiency of your unit.

        Modern walk-in coolers are designed with energy-efficient components, such as insulated panels and energy-saving compressors, to reduce operating costs.
